dedupe_keys.name: muklimo 3 urban climate model deutscher wetterdienst

description: MUKLIMO_3, the three-dimensional micro-scale urban climate model, simulates wind, air temperature and humidity fields over a day in cities for land use and development planning. The Deutscher Wetterdienst developed and used it for about 20 years in many projects on the climatic effects of land use change and on the climate of whole cities, with a basic flow version and a thermodynamic version described in DWD Reports 240 and 248. The thermodynamic version adds heat and moisture budget equations and a one-dimensional soil model coupled through a canopy model, runs on grids of about 20 m to 100 m, and treats built areas as a porous medium described by at least 13 classes of building fraction, height and sealed and green shares, plus forest, park and open space. Coverage is any city under fair weather. Format and access: documentation and reports on the DWD site. Licence: DWD no longer uses the model and no longer issues licences, and is moving to PALM-4U. Caveats: it is built for fair weather situations only. It supports heat exposure and green infrastructure planning in cities. Related catalogue records are PALM-4U and ENVI-met.
